items.hook: 7 pandals · 1 night: Salt Lake Master Route

caption.en:
Salt Lake Durga Puja 2026: which of these 7 pandals did you make it to? 🙋

The walking order from our guide: AE Block, FD Block, Durga Pujo Ground, IA Block, BJ Block, EE Block and CK Block. About 7.9 km and 11,576 steps from City Centre Metro.

All 7? Just one? Tell us in the comments which ones you saw 👇

Every area's route stays free in our guide.
